A tiny armored knight stands frozen far below, dwarfed entirely by the dragon looming overhead.
A shaft of golden god-rays pierces the stormclouds behind, backlighting the dragon's enormous spread wings.
Scattered picked-clean bones of past prey litter the rocky ground far beneath the dragon's perch.
A distant volcano erupts on the horizon, its orange glow silhouetting the dragon against churning smoke.
A panicked flock of birds scatters wildly in all directions far below the circling dragon.
A crumbling ruined tower, half-buried in earth, sits small and forgotten beneath the dragon's shadow.
A massive storm rolls in behind, its black wall of cloud dwarfed only by the dragon.
A second dragon, tiny as a sparrow, circles the far horizon beyond the foreground beast.
Glowing amber eggs rest in a nearby nest, radiating soft heat beneath the watching dragon.
A shattered sword and cracked shield lie scattered at the base of the dragon's feet.
The full moon hangs enormous behind the dragon, its pale face framing wings spread wide.
A lone adventurer, barely visible, picks their way through rubble far beneath the dragon's gaze.
Bleached ribcages and shattered skulls of enormous beasts form a graveyard below the dragon's roost.
God-rays fan outward from behind a mountain peak, catching the dragon mid-flight in golden columns.
A distant volcanic peak vents a slow red plume, painting the sky behind the dragon crimson.
Hundreds of starlings explode outward from the treeline, fleeing the shadow the dragon casts below.
A collapsed stone fortress, swallowed by vines, lies half-buried in the valley beneath the dragon.
Towering stormclouds churn and flash with lightning far behind, making the dragon's silhouette burn fiercer.
Far across the canyon, a second dragon hovers tiny and distant, watching the larger beast below.
A clutch of three glowing eggs pulses with inner fire in a nest of scorched bones.
A broken greatsword, its blade snapped clean, rests half-buried beneath one enormous scaled foot.
The rising moon, impossibly vast tonight, glows behind the dragon's neck like a pale halo.
A small figure in traveling clothes freezes mid-step on a distant road, staring upward in terror.
The jawbone of something colossal curves up from the dirt, dwarfed still by the dragon above.
A wall of black storm presses in from the sea, lightning threading through clouds behind the dragon.
